build_chat_completion_kwargs: build chat.completions.create() kwargs for ~16 OpenAI-compatible providers with provider-specific max_tokens, reasoning, and temperature handling
sanitize_messages_for_provider: sanitize messages by stripping Codex Responses API fields that strict chat-completions providers reject with 400/422
normalize_openai_response: normalize OpenAI ChatCompletion response to NormalizedResponse preserving reasoning, tool_calls provider_data, and usage stats
validate_chat_response: validate that a chat completion response has valid choices before downstream processing
extract_cache_statistics: extract OpenRouter/OpenAI cache hit and write statistics from prompt_tokens_details in the response usage
